title: tf.contrib.crf doesn't support sequences of length 1
body:
[`tf.contrib.crf`](https://www.tensorflow.org/versions/master/api_docs/python/contrib.crf/) doesn't support sequences of length 1.

For example, if I run the example on https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/tree/master/tensorflow/contrib/crf and replace `num_words = 20` by `num_words = 1`, I get the error:
